Aspect of the Nightingale.descriptionOnly: its reroll against a charm effect, once a minute, is told here

Baphomet's Blessing.descriptionOnly: its gore's damage by size and the head slot's melded items are told here; its polymorph immunity spares this spell itself

Beacon of Luck.descriptionOnly: its allies' reroll of a saving throw is told here

Burst of Glory.descriptionOnly: its temporary hit points, 1 per caster level (20 at most), are told here

Channel Vigor.descriptionOnly: the limbs' focus gives haste's effect, told on its own entry

Deadeye's Arrow.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Defending Bone.descriptionOnly: until it has prevented 5 points of damage per caster level (50 at most); none with damage reduction from another source

Face of the Devourer.descriptionOnly: its bite's damage by size is told here

Firebelly.descriptionOnly: its breath's fire damage is told here

Fractions of Heal and Harm.descriptionOnly: no path: the next area spell deals 75% of its damage and heals the caster the rest (of 40 hit points, 30 hit points dealt and 10 hit points healed), at the table

Gozreh's Trident.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Hairline Fractures.descriptionOnly: only on a creature with the earth subtype; stone's hardness 5 and 10 hit points an inch are its own

Hunter's Blessing.descriptionOnly: tracking the chosen type in the chosen terrain untrained, even at DC 11 or higher, is told here

Ice Armor.descriptionOnly: its protection is a breastplate's, told here; the armor's hardness 0 and 30 hit points are its own, and fire damage lowers its armor bonus

Inheritor's Smite.descriptionOnly: no path: +5 sacred on its next melee attack roll and on the bull rush after it, a single roll each, at the table

Maddening Oubliette.descriptionOnly: no path: its penalty of –1 to –5 is on the target's Will save to escape, one for each round spent in the oubliette; the confusion (or insanity after 10 rounds) on its return is told here

Monstrous Extremities.descriptionOnly: no path: its natural weapons' secondary attacks, at base attack bonus –5 and half the Strength bonus on damage, are told here

Pick Your Poison.descriptionOnly: only after a poison affects the subject during the spell, in place of the poison's effect

Seducer's Eyes.descriptionOnly: 1 + 1 for every 4 caster levels, +5 at most; not against those the caster or allies attack or threaten

Smite Abomination.descriptionOnly: the undead is the caster's pick; the higher of its Charisma and Wisdom modifiers on attack rolls and its caster level on damage, melee only; it bypasses the undead's damage reduction and doesn't stack with a paladin's smite

Spawn Calling.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Tracking Mark.descriptionOnly: its Survival DCs to track the target are 5 lower, at the table

Vengeful Stinger.descriptionOnly: its tail's attack of opportunity, damage and poison are told here
